title: Testing & Commissioning Permit
name: Testing & Commissioning Permit
description: Controls energisation, functional testing and commissioning where systems may move, start, become live, pressurised or otherwise transition from construction to operational state.

sections.title: READINESS FOR TEST / COMMISSIONING
items: Construction work affecting the system is sufficiently complete
Outstanding defects relevant to safe testing are understood and controlled
Isolation boundaries and interfaces with adjacent systems are identified
People who could be affected have been informed
Required specialist competence / authorisation is available

sections.title: ENERGISATION / FUNCTIONAL TEST CONTROLS
items: The person controlling energisation / start-up is identified
Unexpected movement, rotation, heat, pressure, voltage or discharge has been considered
Guards and barriers are in place unless removal is specifically controlled
Exclusion zones and communications are established
Emergency stop / shutdown arrangements are known and tested where applicable
Only authorised persons may alter the system state

fields.label: Expected Live / Moving / Pressure / Heat Hazards

sections.title: RESULTS AND HANDOVER
items: Test results are recorded against the approved procedure
Temporary overrides / bypasses are removed or formally recorded
Alarms, interlocks and safety devices are restored / verified
The final system state is clearly communicated
Any failed test or defect is made safe before the permit closes
